_declared_values.quarantine: Read against episode_spec's forbidden_claims, one by one. (1) No card says fatigue caused this: the only fatigue card is the Board's own sentence that the degree of contribution cannot be conclusively determined. (2) No card says the captain lied: the application card carries the question, the answer card carries what he wrote, and the company card is the vice-president's quoted sentence about an incomplete answer. (3) No card blames the first officer's pay or her commute for the accident; the pay cards sit in ACT_3 where the film is describing the arrangements, and the 'easy story' numberticker is explicitly labelled THE EASY STORY, which the narration then takes apart. (4) The fifteen-hundred-hour card states, in the film's own words, that it would not have changed this flight. (5) No card calls either pilot unqualified; the 13.1 per cent card exists precisely so the record cannot be read as proof of a dangerous man. (6) No card characterises either pilot's state of mind; the closest, the ACT_3 closing quote, is the Board's own sentence and is attributed to the Board. (7) No card touches the deaths, the fire or the house: the only impact card gives the distance and the place, 'five nautical miles north-east of the airport, on a house in Clarence Center', and stops there -- no count of the dead appears on any card. (8) The database cards say what the Act required, not that the database exists because of this crash; Public Law 111-216 has not been opened, so nothing is attributed to the statute text itself.
